releases.displayName: “Please Be Happy” — Chinese localization update Now Available

items.text: Thank you for your continued support of Please Be Happy! The official Simplified Chinese version is now available.
The Chinese version is currently available at a 50% launch discount. An additional 10% discount is also applied when purchasing the bundle.
We invite you to join Miho on this journey, where you will explore themes of love and trust, life and death, and reflect on what happiness truly means—and what it means to be human.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/844670/Please_Be_Happy/"]

The Official Artbook has also been updated with Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese support. In the artbook, you'll find behind-the-scenes development stories, beautiful illustrations, and detailed character designs.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226570/Please_Be_Happy__Official_Artbook/"]
Please Be Happy x Upwards, Rain! The Post Office of Farewells
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/78273/Please_Be_Happy__Upwards_Rain_Bundle/"]Please Be Happy - Deluxe Edition bundle
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29200/Please_Be_Happy__Deluxe_Edition/"]
Q: Do I need to purchase the Chinese version separately?
A: No. All players who already own Please Be Happy will receive the Chinese update for free.
Q: How do I switch the game to Chinese?
A: If you have previously installed the game, you can right-click it in your Steam Library, select “Properties” → “Language,” and choose your preferred language.

For first-time installations, the game will usually follow your Steam client language automatically. If the game launches in a different language, you can also change the language in the in-game “Settings” → “General” menu.
Q: What does the Chinese localization include?
A: This update includes full Chinese language support, including Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, for all story content, branching storylines, UI, and system text.
Q: Will my save data be affected after the update?
A: No. Existing save data remains compatible and can continue to be used without restarting the game.
Q: How can I report translation issues?
A: You may report localization issues through the following channels:
Join our QQ player group: 759530704 and contact support staff
Submit feedback via the questionnaire (“click here”)
We will continue collecting feedback and improving the localization experience.
If you enjoy Please Be Happy, we would greatly appreciate it if you could share it with others and follow our social media channels for the latest updates and development news.

items.text: [p align="start"]【※日本語は英語の下に掲載しています。Japanese version can be found below.】
[p align="start"]Hello, everyone!

[p align="start"]Please Be Happy 2.0.1 has just been released, which fixes the Unity Runtime (UnityPlayer) CVE-2025-59489 security vulnerability, as well as a few minor issues in the game that were either reported by the community, or were found in testing.
[p align="start"]As always, thank you for continuing to support Studio Élan!
[p align="start"]On PC, it targets Unity SDK version 2021.3.40f1. (※ The CVE-2025-59489 Unity Runtime security vulnerability has been patched.)
Patched the CVE-2025-59489 Unity Runtime security vulnerability.
Improved workaround introduced in 2.0 for an issue with AMD’s amdvlk64 GPU driver.
Improved handling for extremely low-end (early 2010s) integrated graphics boards.
Optimised and decreased size of the game. Most notably affects the demo, which is now much smaller.
Fixed a typo in the Korean localisation of Chapter 1 Scene 10.
Fixed a rendering issue with Elijah’s speech bubble that could occur under certain circumstances.
Improved texture compression behaviour.

notes.title: 【Important】 Statement regarding Unity Runtime (UnityPlayer) security vulnerability CVE-2025-59489

items.text: [p align="start"]This update contains a fix for the recently-discovered Unity Runtime (UnityPlayer) security vulnerability, CVE-2025-59489 .

[p align="start"]Due to external circumstances, we are locked to using a specific version of the Unity SDK (2021.3.40f1/6fcab7dbbbc1) — however, please rest assured that despite this fact, our automated build process now automatically patches the CVE security vulnerability at build-time, and the game is safe to have installed on your device.
[p align="start"]We have also reissued patched builds for our other Unity game, Summer at the Edge of the Universe.
[p align="start"]For more information, please refer to Unity’s official developer documentation on this matter: https://unity.com/security/sept-2025-01
[p align="start"]As always, thank you for supporting Studio Élan.

notes.title: Regarding older versions of the game

items.text: [p align="start"]※ For those who choose to use older versions of the game via the "Betas" tab, please note that at this time of writing, 1.x versions of the game have not yet been retroactively patched. (※ 2.0 has been patched.)
[p align="start"]Please remain patient as we set up the infrastructure to reissue new, patched builds of these old versions.
『Please Be Happy』2.0.1をリリースしました。このアップデートでは、Unity Runtime（UnityPlayer）に関するセキュリティ脆弱性CVE-2025-59489を修正し、コミュニティから報告いただいたものや開発側の内部テストで発見された、いくつかの不具合を修正しています。
いつもStudio Élanを応援していただきありがとうございます…！
PC版では、Unity SDKバージョン2021.3.40f1をターゲットしています。（※ Unity Runtimeのセキュリティ脆弱性CVE-2025-59489は修正済みです。）
Unity Runtime（UnityPlayer）のセキュリティ脆弱性CVE-2025-59489を修正しました。
バージョン2.0で導入したAMDのGPUドライバーamdvlk64に関する不具合対策方法を改良しました。
非常に低スペックなオンボードグラフィックボード（〜初期2010年代ごろ）への対応を改善しました。
ゲームのサイズを最適化・縮小しました。特に体験版が大幅に軽くなっています。
韓国語の翻訳の第1章シーン10のタイポを修正しました。
特定条件下でエライジャの吹き出し表示に不具合が発生する問題を修正しました。
テクスチャ圧縮の挙動を改善しました。

notes.title: 【重要】Unity Runtime（UnityPlayer）のセキュリティ脆弱性CVE-2025-59489について

items.text: このアップデートには、最近発見されたUnity Runtime（UnityPlayer）のセキュリティ脆弱性CVE-2025-59489に対する新しい修正が含まれています。
外部要因により、Unity SDKの特定バージョン（2021.3.40f1/6fcab7dbbbc1）に固定されていますが、ビルド時に自動的にCVE脆弱性を修正する仕組みを導入しました。
また、Studio Élanの別のUnityゲーム『Summer at the Edge of the Universe』についても、修正版ビルドを再配布しました。
詳しい情報については、Unity公式開発者向けドキュメントはこちらへ： https://unity.com/ja/security/sept-2025-01
いつもStudio Élanを応援していただきありがとうございます。

古いバージョンの修正版ビルド再配布の準備を行っています。完了まで少し時間がかかりますので、お待ちください。
今後ともよろしくお願いいたします。
Hello, everyone!
We're so happy to announce that there are now Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean translations for the demo of Please Be Happy — that's the entirety of the first chapter!

We are looking into options to bring the full game into these languages as well, but due to various circumstances, there are no current active plans to do so. We haven't given up though, and we wanted to bring a little bit of PBH into these languages, especially to see if there is interest in these and if we should pursue this further via crowdfunding.
An incredible thank you to all of our translators who have worked hard and waited patiently for these translations.
Simplified Chinese Translation
Provided by Hakui Team
Translation: Yuan, Rena, DF, Rain, X, Alwaysmadowl, Hanasaki
Testing: Alwaysmadowl, Yuan, KuromitsuDango, Litha
Korean Translation by KyleHeren

Additionally, while the contents of the game are identical to previous versions, the game engine itself has undergone massive (over 662!) technical changes, with most of the internals almost fully rewritten in order to better support translations going forward, as well as fixing quite a large number of issues.
The full changelog for this update will be made available in a few hours.
As always, thank you for continuing to support Studio Élan!
〜 adirosa and Karen/あけみ (akemin_dayo)

P.S. Our next games are available for wishlisting - if you want a thrilling dark tale by many of the staff behind Please Be Happy, please consider checking out and wishlisting A Tithe in Blood! If you want a heartwarming tale of adventure and love, please check out Upwards, Rain! Both releasing this summer!!!
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for your bug reports and I hope you've been enjoying the game!

notes.title: With this new update, we have

items.text: Added Linux builds
Added OpenDyslexic as a font
Added tooltips to settings to help clarify what some of these things do
Made 100%-ing the game actually possible - as we've fixed some typos, those will count as 'new lines' and will need to be read again for the final 100%. Sorry about the inconvenience!
Added confirm screen on exit
Fixed chapter 5 achievement error
Fixed bugged episode in the extras menu "On Wings of Night"
Fixed various voice lines and typos
Fixed Korean display error in Log
implementing Steam Cloud Saves
updating the demo to the new engine
controller support: Thank you for your patience and kind words.

We've fixed some more voice line errors and typos.
Hello! Thank you for all the support.

We've fixed a few voice line errors.
We are still compiling edits for more voice line errors and typos, and will try to have another patch as soon as possible.
